name: Banking Fund Transfer & Available Balance Verification
description: Submitting a fund transfer decrements origin account balance and verifies sufficient funds before execution.
preconditions: Active checking or savings account with positive balance
invariants: Transfers exceeding current balance must be rejected with insufficient funds error
Successful transfer updates available balance by exact amount plus transaction fee

scenario_templates.title: Transfer Funds to Linked Account
scenario_templates.objective: Verify submitting transfer within balance limits updates account balance.

negative_scenarios.title: Transfer Exceeding Available Balance
negative_scenarios.objective: Verify transfer exceeding balance is blocked with insufficient funds error.

domain_assumptions: Selector hints, routes, option values and expected texts in this template were authored against one reference application (SauceDemo-style e-commerce). They are hypotheses: the planner uses a step or expectation only when it is observed on the current target.
